description: This Java source file defines the utility class DbUtil, which provides methods for setting up and managing a test database connection, including database creation, connection configuration, and Liquibase schema initialization. It is used within the OpenMRS project for testing purposes.

classes.name: DbUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing test database setup, including creation, configuration, and schema initialization within the OpenMRS testing environment.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseCreated
methods.description: Ensures the test database is created and schema is initialized; avoids re-creation if already done.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new test database with specified parameters based on current system properties.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Executes the SQL statement to create the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: getConnectionUrl
methods.description: Returns the JDBC URL template based on database type (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
